Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 30

“The embodied self within everyone's body is eternally beyond killing, Bharata. Therefore you should not grieve for any being.”

The argument closes by widening from Arjuna's relatives to every being on the field, including strangers and enemies. A consolation that applied only to loved ones would not have been consolation at all.
